lines.text: Yesterday's lesson: they can open anything. So today... we go UP.
Five feet up. Let's see those little hands reach THAT.
...With a ladder. And a grown-up holding the bottom. Always.
No. No no no. They CLIMB?
lines.why: said as they climb: the wide shot keeps them in view

lines.text: Sharp claws. And look -- they can turn their back feet around, and climb down head first.

lines.why: called out to the raccoons, from far away

lines.text: Up was a good idea. But up isn't enough. They're better climbers than I am.
...Unless the box only comes down when I want it to.

msgs.text: how do YOU get up there dear?
raccoons climb trees for fun grandpa

rows.text: sharp claws + back feet that turn around
